author: claude
expected: Processing completes and the DSM is available as a map; no 'Processing failed'. Customer file A from the CL-80003 folder (rotation term about 1e-13, confirmed in P1).

preconditions.text: fixture present; sha256 recorded; its geotransform rotation/shear terms read and recorded before upload
CT account logged in on every target
test-data site a0000001 exists in the CT org on staging

source.locator: description bullet 1, plus CL-80003 acceptance criterion 1 (qa/cache/clickup/0000fake001.json)

requirement.text:
Check so import of 2 of the .tif files here works
A GeoTIFF with a negligible rotation such as 1.62e-13 imports successfully. Test with the actual files

steps.text: Deliver the fixture to the target: tablets via adb -s <serial> push into a test folder under Download; W044 via scp to webpc044
Open the authorized test site 'QA engine' (site a0000001, staging)
Maps page import flow (as tests/2026-10-09-terrain-resolution/tools/maps_import.py): pick the file, name it QA_<deviceTag>_CL80003_A, choose the site, Next (cloud write: one new dataset)
Wait for the server-side DSM processing: poll the dataset's status in the app and with a read-only API GET, up to a time limit set from source
Read the final status in the app (status label, any error text) and from the API; screenshot
Leave the app where it started (always)

steps_note: Fixture: customer .tif A from the CL-80003 Drive folder, put by the user in tests/2026-10-22-dsm-import-cl80003/files/; sha256 added when the case is completed. Customer data, uploaded as CL-80003 asks.
title: Customer DSM A with near-zero rotation imports (CL-80003)
